scientific_primary: contextual applicability and testable qualified-context specification; no EA superiority presupposition

steven_proposal.architecture: validate anchor INSTEAD OF current intent derivation

ying_response.architecture: validate predeclared anchor THEN derive intent from current context

protocol.oracle_basis: source-owner signed action policy, independently defined materiality, exceptions, decision horizon and participant-visible evidence

anchor_regimes.label: ENUMERATIVE_VERIFIABLE
anchor_regimes.predicate: Explicit finite material conditions including no critical dependency S->R, plus source standing and freshness
anchor_regimes.precondition: Source owner approves explicit dependency clause and its legitimate verifier
anchor_regimes.expected_delta: Known current edge can be detected in anchor check; stage 2 still executed, incremental contribution may be zero
anchor_regimes.claim_limit: Known coverage only, no extrapolation to unenumerated future relations

anchor_regimes.label: GENERAL_WITH_OPERATIONAL_VERIFIER
anchor_regimes.predicate: Current applicable source safety/operational-context condition with a named evidence method, scope, expiry, and UNKNOWN disposition
anchor_regimes.precondition: General predicate is separately operationally checkable; if it merely says 'still safe' with no evaluation method, declare NON_ADMISSIBLE
anchor_regimes.expected_delta: A generic source may qualify observed changes, but no truth without legitimate evidence; second intent rederivation remains source-required
anchor_regimes.claim_limit: Cannot use tautological source-owned predicate as oracle for its own success

anchor_regimes.label: ILL_DEFINED_GENERAL_NEGATIVE_CONTROL
anchor_regimes.precondition: No named verifier, coverage, time or escalation rule
anchor_regimes.expected_delta: Should be rejected as non-verifiable, not scored as competent R2

tests: anchor check result vs intent rederivation result

controls: active-query branch with bounded legitimate evidence acquisition
unknown_pair.loss_calibration: OWNER_AGREEMENT_REQUIRED; do not assign default numeric scalar; Pareto/constraint reporting allowed

terminal_outcomes.condition: Source-owned policy prohibits isolate(R) because new dependency is material
terminal_outcomes.required_proof: source-approved policy materiality and current evidence

terminal_outcomes.condition: Source-owned exception allows isolate(R) even with new dependency
terminal_outcomes.meaning: context changed but original proposed prohibition not established; preserve policy-qualified decision and context signal
terminal_outcomes.required_proof: policy exception and proportional consequences; NO wrongful-authorization/P score on allowed action

terminal_outcomes.condition: No policy owner or insufficient reference materiality
terminal_outcomes.meaning: scientific applicability effect unestablished; candidate provenance/context specification may remain a research proposal

terminal_outcomes.condition: Competent B2 equals B3 on specified owner-approved outcomes at comparable or lower cost
terminal_outcomes.meaning: no unique EA capability claim; interoperable semantic contract remains separately testable, not thereby validated
terminal_outcomes.required_proof: matched independent results plus separate interface conformance

terminal_outcomes.condition: Identical participant packet and no accessible distinguishing evidence
terminal_outcomes.meaning: no guaranteed world inference possible, bounded legitimate hold under approved policy

parity_surviving_claims.claim: Decision-scoped versioned qualified handoff is a candidate interoperable vocabulary across domains
parity_surviving_claims.not_proven: cross-vendor interoperability, novelty, new capability or EA superiority

parity_surviving_claims.claim: A source-preserving separation of grant authority vs qualified context is an architectural requirement independent of a marketed EA module
parity_surviving_claims.not_proven: that this separation requires any dedicated software

parity_surviving_claims.claim: Conformance is testable for provenance, context scope, freshness, dependency, UNKNOWN, owner, minimal disclosure and return path
parity_surviving_claims.not_proven: native implementations must first be built, independently mapped and tested
